name: Tenbin Gold
oneLiner: tGLD is Tenbin's synthetic gold token tracking one troy ounce via USDC reserves hedged with CME gold futures, with KYC-gated mint and USD stablecoin redemption.
collateral: Synthetic gold exposure, not vaulted bullion: each token represents the USD value of one troy ounce of gold at the LBMA PM spot price. Backed by USDC held on-chain and at prime broker Ripple Prime (formerly Hidden Road), with gold price exposure obtained via CME gold futures. Issued as a Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC debt-note (a UCC Article 12 controllable electronic record)
pegMechanism: KYC-gated mint and redemption through a Controller that processes off-chain signed orders; a Tenbin backend signer holds the on-chain minter role. Redemption pays the gold-denominated value in a USD stablecoin, not physical metal. On-chain pricing uses a Chainlink tGLD/USD blended price feed

listingStatusReview.reason: Missing lane: supply. tGLD's commodity path needs a fresh CoinGecko market cap, which was 54 hours stale on October 25 2026; CoinGecko and DefiLlama do quote a price.

notices.title: Synthetic gold debt-note, no tGLD-specific reserve attestation
notices.message: tGLD is not vaulted physical gold. Each token is a Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) debt-note backed by USDC reserves with gold exposure hedged via CME futures, redeemable only in a USD stablecoin under KYC. No independent attestation of tGLD's own reserves is published; since September 15 2026 a Chainlink Proof of Reserve feed has reported one off-chain reserve total across all Tenbin assets. Public on-chain liquidity is currently minimal.

launchPhaseDetail: Live on Ethereum mainnet since 2026-02-10, with KYC-gated mint and redemption (about $597K market cap, 139.74 tGLD, 72 holders on September 27 2026, up from ~54 tGLD and ~36 holders in June). tGLD is a synthetic gold debt-note from Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC: USDC-collateralized with gold exposure hedged via CME futures, KYC-gated mint/redeem, redeemable in USD stablecoin (no physical metal). Its only on-chain pool is a dormant Uniswap V4 tGLD/USDC pool; since September 9 2026 1inch has also routed tGLD swaps against USDC quotes supplied by Tenbin itself. CoinGecko's tenbin-gold price ($4,272.46, $597,027 market cap, 139.74 circulating) updated same-day on September 27 2026 on $2.20 of 24-hour volume, so the feed is currently fresh while trading remains near zero; the 14-day price history endpoint returns no points, so freshness continuity is unproven and the gold price-freshness gate has not been re-run. On October 25 2026 CoinGecko's market cap was 54 hours old, so its supply lane fails freshness; live tracking begins once that lane is fresh. A staked variant stGLD (ERC-4626) exists, and sibling FX tokens tBRL and tMXN are now listed as Ethereum mainnet deployments in the Tenbin docs; in May 2026 Tenbin deprecated LayerZero following internal security audits and migrated tGLD (and the FX siblings) exclusively to Chainlink CCIP. Q3 2026 audit reports from Zellic and Verilog were published to the contracts repository on August 26 2026; remediation fixes landed through August 31, and v1.5.1 and bug-bounty information followed on September 14. Since September 15 2026 a Chainlink Proof of Reserve feed on Base has published Tenbin's attested off-chain reserve figure, a single total across all Tenbin assets, and the docs name Ripple Prime (formerly Hidden Road) as digital asset custodian.

featuredContent.title: Galaxy Digital leads $7M investment in Tenbin to build improved tokenized gold and FX markets
featuredContent.description: Tenbin Labs raised a $7M seed led by Galaxy Ventures to build an on-chain tokenization protocol for gold and FX, starting with the gold token tGLD.

featuredContent.title: JPEG Trading launches RWA curation business with tGLD on Euler
featuredContent.description: JPEG Trading launched an RWA curation business with tGLD as its inaugural curated asset, standing up the first DeFi lending vaults for tGLD on Euler.

milestones.title: Security audits completed
milestones.description: Independent audits by Spearbit, Fuzzland, Verilog, and 0xleastwood, alongside Certora formal verification.

milestones.title: $7M seed led by Galaxy Ventures
milestones.description: Galaxy Ventures led a $7M seed with Wintermute Ventures, FalconX, GSR, Nascent, Variant, Archetype, and Bankless Ventures.

milestones.title: tGLD deployed to Ethereum mainnet (private beta)
Tenbin adopts Chainlink CCIP for cross-chain expansion
JPEG Trading launches RWA curation with tGLD as inaugural Euler asset
milestones.description: JPEG Trading launched an RWA curation business with tGLD as its inaugural curated asset, deploying the first DeFi lending vaults for tGLD on Euler with co-deployed capital.

milestones.title: Q3 2026 audits by Zellic and Verilog published with remediation reports
milestones.description: Reports dated August 3 2026 (Zellic final, Verilog marked draft) with remediation notes were added to the tenbin-contracts repository on August 26 2026, followed by fix commits through August 31. Whether the remediated contracts are deployed on mainnet is not stated.

milestones.title: tGLD, tBRL and tMXN become swappable through 1inch
milestones.description: 1inch announced that Tenbin's Ethereum ERC-20 tokens tGLD, tBRL and tMXN can be swapped through its aggregator, with Tenbin quoting liquidity against USDC. 1inch states it is not the issuer and makes no representation about price tracking or collateralization.

milestones.title: Tenbin ships v1.5.1 and a bug bounty after landing audit remediations
milestones.description: Following the August 3 audit publications, Tenbin landed Verilog remediation fixes from August 21 to 31, including P0 and P1 severity items, then tagged v1.5.1 and added bug-bounty information on September 14. The beta float is unchanged at 139.74 tGLD with 72 holders on September 27, and CoinGecko's tenbin-gold price updated same-day on $2.20 of 24-hour volume.

milestones.title: Tenbin publishes off-chain reserves through a Chainlink Proof of Reserve feed
milestones.description: Tenbin's documentation describes an attested snapshot of off-chain reserves held at Ripple Prime, computed inside a Google Cloud Confidential Space enclave and published on Base through Chainlink's Tenbin Aggregated Off-Chain Reserves feed (0x7b1C8C60c05913aF3Aa21BaE3B32A02Ab4f39Bd3). The feed's first round is dated September 15 2026 and covers all Tenbin assets together. On-chain vault collateral is excluded from the figure because it can be read directly on Ethereum.
